card.name: Words just before a count or quantity
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, in, has, there, increasing) or a space right where a number or amount such as 'many', 'a number of' or a figure is about to come. It fits sentences about how many people, places or cases.

modes.label: Space before a figure
modes.description: The blank space just before a numeral that counts people or things.
modes.example: A total of<< >>480 freshmen are enrolled this semester

modes.label: Linking word before many/number
modes.description: A short word that leads into 'many', 'a number of' or a report of cases.
modes.example: Hyponatremia has occurred as a result of treatment with imipramine pamoate capsules .<< In>> many cases, hyponatremia

modes.label: Has/there before reports
modes.description: 'has' or 'there' leading into 'been reports' or 'are N' counts.
modes.example: Throughout the world,<< there>> are 160 ISBN agencies;

card.writes: It pushes toward small counts like five, six or seven and away from huge amounts like millions and billions.
card.plain: It fires at the spot right before a number or 'many' is stated, and favors small counts over giant ones.
